# iCryptos Dashboard

> A mobile-friendly dashboard for discovering crypto earning projects, airdrops, faucets, and investment opportunities. Curated and updated daily by TTEarnCrypto.

## Key Pages

- Home: https://ttearncrypto.f9xr.org/dashboards/
- Dashboard (Desktop): https://ttearncrypto.f9xr.org/dashboards/index.html
- Dashboard (Mobile): https://ttearncrypto.f9xr.org/dashboards/m-index.html
- Themes Hub: https://ttearncrypto.f9xr.org/dashboards/themes/
- News Hub: https://ttearncrypto.f9xr.org/dashboards/newshub/classic.html
- Sitemap: https://ttearncrypto.f9xr.org/dashboards/page/sitemap.html

- Home: https://ttearncrypto.f9xr.org/Home/earncrypto.html

## Data

Projects are fetched via JSONP from Blogger feeds. Each project includes name, URL, published date, tags (category, wallet, token), and status (active/inactive).
